objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperlessly from creation and editing to release, distribution, archiving, revision, validity extension, invalidation, reactivation, translation and evaluation.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: By default includes document type abbreviation, a cross-client consecutive 4-digit number per type, and title.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Part of the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and documented per released version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and used in workflows and reports.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Document property maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Document property maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign the registered author and personal authorizations.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reviewers and personal authorizations.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers and personal authorizations.

attributes.name: releaser_incl_translation
attributes.description: Attribute used to set authorizations, including translation, during reactivation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date used with the period of extended validity to calculate the valid until date.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which a check of extended validity is necessary.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration defined for each document type; after it expires documents are physically deleted.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Language version that must be released before translation can be carried out.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which released translated documents are visible to authorized readers.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Type selected when creating a new document object; can have templates and defined validity and archive periods.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation included in the document name by default and not language-independent.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period defined for each document type; the standard is 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration defined for each document type; the standard is 10 years.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or new documents generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person involved as reader, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, initiator, editor or workflow participant.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used for assigning authorizations, reader access, distribution, and archive access.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read and change rights assigned to groups or persons for each document.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and completed in release, review, acknowledgement, validity extension, AKS and reactivation processes.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented per released version.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for a document without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to be checked before validity expires.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate documents that have no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate invalidated documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document with user groups or persons for e-mail distribution or acknowledgement.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to users involved in workflow, change proposals, validity extension, release, distribution, and acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation requested from persons or users of assigned groups when a document is distributed for acknowledgement.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific display populated based on distribution groups and used to list relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search available for documents in the system.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of master data with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: company
objs.description: Relevant company maintained as a document property.

objs.name: area_of_validity
objs.description: Area of validity maintained as a document property.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: The corresponding document type is selected when attaching a new information object.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: A document template can be selected when creating new objects.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: A pure object cover can be created for external files or generated documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: New documents can be generated based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_property
evts.description: Standardized and customer-specific metadata can be maintained automatically or by the user in document properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The document content is edited with an implemented editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Once the document has been saved it is converted to PDF and displayed on the web.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: A saved document is automatically and system-supported converted to PDF.

evts.name: display_document_as_pdf
evts.description: The current converted version is displayed on the web.

evts.name: change_document_content
evts.description: Subsequent changes to document content are possible and can trigger a new version.

evts.name: change_document_property
evts.description: Subsequent changes to properties are possible and can trigger a new version for released documents.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Group and person-related authorizations are assigned in document properties.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Participants in the release process are assigned via property editing.

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Additional information can be added to each document by attaching a new information object.

evts.name: release_additional_information
evts.description: Additional information is released directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_information
evts.description: Additional information is published directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Additional information can be deleted again directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Attachments can be added to each document by attaching a new information object.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modification of attachments triggers a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Archiving of attachments triggers a new version of the associated main document; released attachments are archived with release of the next version.

evts.name: start_release_process
evts.description: The 3-step release process is started by a co-author or the author after document creation, content and attribute maintenance, and document control definition.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Only the registered author signs in the first workflow step of Creator.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Assigned reviewers check the document; all assigned participants must complete their task positively for release to be triggered.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Assigned releasers complete the release; one positive completion is sufficient to finally release the document.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A rejection during review or release cancels the workflow for all subsequent participants immediately after the first rejection.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participants complete their tasks with an electronic signature.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Signatures of individual participants are documented in the system for each released version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: If a valid and released document is revised, a new version is automatically created in editing status.

evts.name: create_document_version
evts.description: A new document version is created for revisions, attachment changes, scheduled change proposals, or reactivation.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Employees with author rights can create change proposals for a document.

evts.name: inform_document_author
evts.description: When a change proposal is created, the author of the underlying document is informed by e-mail.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: If the change proposal is scheduled for implementation, a new version of the document is created.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Completed change proposals are no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Thirty days before validity expires, a request for validity extension is created by the system.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The request for validity extension must be processed with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declaring additional validity deletes the request for validity extension and updates the valid until date.

evts.name: delete_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The request for validity extension is deleted when additional validity is declared or when a revised version is released.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: The process for validity extension is automatically terminated when a revised version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Users with write access can create a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: After attachment of the request for AKS, the workflow for processing the request starts automatically.

evts.name: check_request_for_aks
evts.description: The creator of the request checks the request and the document in the first step of one AKS process.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Documents and their attachments are declared invalid and archived.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archiving withdraws authorizations for the document except for the archive group.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: All rights except for the archive group are revoked when a document is out of force.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period has expired, documents are physically deleted.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A request for reactivation is created in the provided folder and the corresponding document is selected.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: The workflow for a request for reactivation starts automatically.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The creator of the request confirms reactivation in the workflow step.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Invalidated documents are re-validated; a new version is created and metadata, properties, distribution list, authorizations and attachments are restored or set.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Attachments archived with the document are also reactivated.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Distribution lists can be maintained for each document by assigning user groups or persons.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_e_mail
evts.description: Assigned users and users of assigned groups are informed by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_document_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Assigned persons and users of assigned groups are requested by e-mail to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Each recipient confirms acknowledgement through a workflow-supported task without a signature.

evts.name: notify_author_team
evts.description: The author team receives an overview of unconfirmed acknowledgements and notification when all acknowledgements are confirmed.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: User and role-specific dashboards are filled based on distribution groups in the distribution list per document.

evts.name: evaluate_document
evts.description: Reports provide evaluations and searches of documents or acknowledgements depending on selected parameters.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content can be translated into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: The translated version must be checked with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version must be released before it is visible to authorized readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: For each document in a multi-client system, visible clients can be specified.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: A new document must be created in a client to make a local addition to a document.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: A reference to the original document is created for a local addition.

o2o.description: A document is created with selection of a corresponding document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
A pure object cover can be created and used for uploaded or generated document content.
External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover.
A document can be supplemented with additional information.
A document can be supplemented with attachments; attachments are automatically released with the main document.
Documents can reference other documents, and local documents can reference original documents.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with master data.
IT applications are given as an example of master data.
The IT applications property must be maintained to link documents to IT applications.
Relevant companies can be maintained via document properties.
Areas of validity can be maintained via document properties.
Users can be assigned to documents as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, initiator, editor, or distribution recipient.
User groups can be assigned to documents for reader authorization and distribution.
Users are assigned to user groups such as Authors, Reviewer, releaser, Reader - Document Management, Archive, and Business Admin group.
Authorizations are assigned specifically to documents.
Read and change rights can be assigned to a group of users for each document.
Personal authorizations are assigned for author, co-author, reviewer, and releaser attributes.
Workflow tasks are completed by assigned workflow participants.
Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature.
Signatures are documented in the system for each released document version and can be printed as document content.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for AKS can be created for a selected document.
A corresponding document is selected for reactivation in a request for reactivation.
Distribution lists can be maintained for each document.
Distribution is maintained by assigning user groups.
Distribution is maintained by assigning persons.
Acknowledgements relate to the current released document version and are listed by status.
Dashboards list documents relevant to users.
Reports provide evaluations and searches of documents stored in the system.
The acknowledgement report lists acknowledgements depending on status.
For each document in a multi-client system, clients in which it is visible can be specified.
